blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) on Tuesday said it summoned the registered owner and driver of a vehicle that allegedly ran over and killed a minor in Pasig City. According to the LTO in a statement, both the registered owner and driver were directed to appear before the agency on Sept. 22, 2026, as they face violations of reckless driving and improper person to operate a motor vehicle, which is on top of other liabilities that may be established as the investigation continues.
